newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel capped at 130.06, target 129.42.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel capped at 130.06, target 129.42.

text.p: September notionnel futures on MATIF face further consolidation on Tuesday, as long as they remain under the pivot 130.06 level, technical analysts said.
Christian Bado, senior technical analyst at Ferrier Lullin in Geneva, said the first objective on the downside was at 129.42, the 38.2 percent retracement of the entire upmove from 126.40 on June 2.
From there, the market should build up a fairly solid base and may rebound slightly before resuming its down move towards 128.84, he said.
"We are in a downtrend after putting in place a double top around the 131.20 area, so we should see a setback to 128.84, maybe even 128.30," said Bado.
By 0805 GMT, September notionnel futures were up 0.06 at 129.82.
Charles Diebel, senior technical analyst at Technical Data in London, agreed the pivot level for the contract was 130.06, an intraday high.
"While we're still under there, it looks like we're going lower," he said, adding 129.68 was first prop on the downside.

"If we see acceleration through there -- and momentum studies certainly suggest we will -- we'll go all the way down to 129.02," said Diebel. Charts show the market hit a daily low at 129.02 on July 1.
By 0820 GMT, September Pibor was up two basis points at 96.45.
